svg.title: How often a closed review concern was not actually fixed
svg.desc: In synthetic revision histories, a sticky outdated-line proxy marked 72.9% of unresolved concerns as resolved. REVAL with three oracle-sampled witnesses had a false-resolution rate of 11%, and 13% with witnesses derived from review comments. Stopping checks after the first success missed 100% of recurrences; REVAL detected 80.4% and 88.3%.

text.font-family: Work Sans, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The comment moved. The bug didn't.

text.font-family: Work Sans, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Synthetic revision histories: 441 review concerns, 1,284 assessments, 12 defect families.
